cohort: 43,735 women who delivered via cesarean delivery at the Maternal-Fetal Medicine Unit
finding: In women undergoing unlabored cesarean delivery, non-β-lactam antibiotics were associated with a higher risk of wound complications compared with β-lactam regimens.
mod_finding: In women undergoing unlabored cesarean delivery, non-β-lactam antibiotics were associated with a higher risk of wound complications compared with β-lactam regimens.
